decisions.reason: A height-adjustable desk system builds directly on the firm's core furniture engineering knowledge, so the firm can read its early results and improve it well.
A chair family fits the firm's established upholstery and seating expertise, and its prominent dedicated page signals strategic commitment.

Floor cushions made from carpets draw on textile knowledge farther from core furniture making, which raises the risk of dropping them, but they are niche, low-cost add-ons that complement the rug line.
An upholstered sofa is related to the firm's seating know-how, but it is only mentioned rather than featured, suggesting weaker commitment and some risk of discontinuation.
A high standing table closely leverages the firm's existing table and desk knowledge and complements the desk system.
A rug collection lies outside the firm's core furniture manufacturing knowledge and is likely sourced or co-developed, but it supports interior-styling offers and has its own featured page.
